results.title: [Bug Bounty] `igamc` calls undefined `igam`, silently discarding ~86% of entropy draws and biasing generated secrets
results.author: 0xzunid
results.body_snippet: ## Summary `S.igamc` in `src/functions/bip39_mnemonic.js` calls a bare `igam(a, x)` that does not exist in its scope. `S.igam` exists as a method on the same object, but the call inside `igamc` never references it, so every invocation that takes the `x < 1.0 || x < a` branch throws `ReferenceError: igam is not defined`. results.title: OTLP nanosecond timestamp overflow in webapp event repository
results.author: nicktrn
results.body_snippet: Several places in the webapp multiply epoch milliseconds by 1,000,000 **before** converting to BigInt, which causes IEEE 754 precision loss (~256ns errors in ~0.2% of cases). results.body_snippet: ## Summary `L_Good.getInvestPower` computes `current_quantity = Q - virtualQty` with checked arithmetic. Swaps reduce `Q` but **never** reduce `virtualQty` (only invest/disinvest touch it), and the safe-line lower bound only stops `Q` at 60% of baseline. For leverage above ~2.5x, `virtualQty` exceeds that 60% floor, so a max-size swap-out pushes `Q` below `virtualQty` — and every subsequent `investGood` reverts with a `Panic(0x11)` arithmetic underflow until `Q` recovers.
